claims.text: Starfish Palliative Care protocol (preferred by some authors): low-dose haloperidol (10-20 mg in 24 h) over benzodiazepines to ↓ anxiety and agitation, so staff can give physical and personal care.
claims.quote: Some authors recommend the Starfish Palliative Care treatment protocol as the preferred treatment model. This protocol recommends low-dose haloperidol (10-20 mg in 24h) over benzodiazepines to reduce anxiety and agitation, improving healthcare providers' capacity to provide physical and personal care.
